name: futpadel
description: Futpadel - football meets padel. 3D multiplayer game (Three.js + Electron + Colyseus).

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB "npm run dev:server" "npm --workspace client run dev:vite"

author: Joa
